result.description: Compact standalone audio recorder designed for location sound, interviews, and ambient capture. The Orchid Lantern S-220 features dual XLR/TRS combo inputs, 32-bit float recording, onboard stereo microphones, and a shock-isolated chassis for handheld or bag-based use. It records to microSD media and includes USB-C file transfer and power support for extended field sessions.
result.title: Orchid Lantern S-220 Field Recorder
result.title_description: Portable field recorder with dual inputs and 32-bit float capture
